#### PR description:

Title says it all, in response to https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51900#issuecomment-5809214111.
Removes the duplicated plugins introduced in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51900 (un-needed because in this cycle it's already available as introduced in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50307).

#### PR validation:

`cmssw` compiles.
Tested using the test file at:

https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/80c037ed1736e249d6b46f12acc645e3f4f1a8e9/HLTriggerOffline/Scouting/test/test.sh#L1-L51
